messages:
deploy-bot: :x: Release pipeline failed on job `build-and-test:canary` for release/2026-03-20 - exit code 1. Artifacts not restored from remote-cache: ERROR: failed to fetch cache key 'kb-xyz-20260320'

alice: ugh, getting the same locally when I tried to repro. `restore: timeout after 60s` in the logs.

ben: can someone paste the full failing task log? I saw a cached artifact 404 in the runner output earlier.

carol: log snippet:
```
Restoring remote cache... attempt 3
GET https://cache.internal/retrieve/kb-xyz-20260320 -> 504 Gateway Timeout
ERROR: remote cache restore timed out after 60s
```

dave: probably the cache proxy in us-west-2 flaked during the release window spike. We had the same window yesterday on canary. We can either rerun or fallback to building from source.

alice: build-from-source will add ~12m to the cut; our change window is tight. Can we rerun just the artifact publish job after bumping restore timeout to 180s?

ben: safe option is revert the PR that introduced the new heavy dependency (sha: `f3a9c2b`). That prevents the need to pull the big cache key entirely.

erin: which PR was that? I can prepare a quick revert if we decide.

alice: it's #4127 (adds dataset-converter wheel). It increased artifact size ~4x.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Canary rollout paused automatically due to pipeline failure. Rollout status: paused. Affected canaries: 2/3.

carol: my vote: attempt a retry with increased timeout + single-job rerun. If it still fails, revert PR and promote the previous canary.

dave: agree. Also let's pin the cache key TTL to avoid eviction mid-cut: add `CACHE_TTL=48h` for the publish job.

ben: quick commands:
```
# increase timeout env and rerun
ci trigger job build-and-test:canary --env RESTORE_TIMEOUT=180
```

erin: I'll open a quick change to CI config and queue the rerun. If it fails again within 15m, I'll submit a revert PR and tag @oncall to approve rollbacks.

alice: sounds good. tagging @oncall now for visibility :bell:

dave: also add a release note to the ticket that we observed remote-cache 504s during change window and reverted if we do.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rerun triggered by erin (job id 3721). Monitor: https://ci.redwood/jobs/3721

ben: if 3721 succeeds, we still need a follow-up to trim that converter wheel or split artifacts into smaller layers. We shouldn't rely on bigger cache keys during peak windows.

carol: agreed. Erin, update the rollback playbook with the specific steps for reverting PR #4127 and promoting previous canary tag `v2026-03-20-rc2`.

erin: will do. watching logs now.

deploy-bot: :x: Job 3721 failed after restore retry - same 504 gateway timeout during cache fetch.

alice: ok revert time. erin, please open the revert PR and request a hotfix cut.

erin: opened revert `revert-4127-f3a9c2b` and kicked off `build-and-test:canary` from the reverted HEAD (job 3723).

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Job 3723 succeeded. Artifacts built from source and published. Canary resume: promoted 3/3. Release can proceed.

ben: good catch everyone. Follow-ups: (1) split heavy wheel, (2) increase cache proxy capacity during change windows, (3) CI config: fallback to build-from-source after 2 cache failures.

dave: I'll file infra tickets for cache autoscale and postmortem notes.

carol: I'll add a short blurb to the release notes describing the rollback and reason.

alice: closing out. Thanks all. :rocket:
